profile_text.body:
ELLIS, also known as the European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems, is a nonprofit organization headquartered in Europe and operating at ellis.eu. It describes itself as a pan-European AI network of excellence that aims to secure lasting international leadership of AI made in Europe by connecting top researchers and creating a multi-centric AI research laboratory. Its activities are organized around Programs, a network of Sites across Europe, and a PhD program. The Programs focus on theoretical foundations, algorithms, and applications such as health and climate, and are led by ELLIS Fellows and Scholars. Sites are described as hubs for AI research that can be made up of local AI research institutions and universities or newly created Institutes.

The ELLIS PhD and Postdoc Program pairs students with researchers across Europe in machine learning, AI, and related fields and offers international exchanges, joint supervision, and a research community. The site states that the University of Stuttgart has been a member of the network since 2021, and that the ELLIS Doctoral Symposium 2026, organized by ELLIS Unit Lisbon, brought together more than 100 PhD students, postdocs, researchers, and AI experts. ELLIS describes its work as connecting researchers and institutions and fostering open, collaborative innovation so that AI made in Europe develops responsibly and benefits society. No litigation, no products, and no MCP servers are recorded for the organization.
